name: STANLEY
author: Sean McCormick
description: Two eras of Kubrick-inspired blogging in one SMACKTALK skin: Michael Heilemann's original Kubrick and Rough Pixels' contemporary KUBRICK 2024 reinterpretation. Choose retro STANLEY or modern STANLEY 2024, keep either stable, or let it occasionally glimpse its counterpart across THE OTHER SIDE.

variants.retro-flicker: STANLEY — THE OTHER SIDE occasionally breaks through
variants.other-flicker: STANLEY 2024 — THE OTHER SIDE occasionally breaks through

other_side_test_mode.label: Crossing Test Mode

options.1: On — cross once after each page load

other_side_test_mode.help: Preview the real Other Side transition without waiting half an hour. Works with all four variants, performs one crossing shortly after each page load, and still respects the visitor's reduced-motion setting.

stanley_2024_hero.label: STANLEY 2024 Hero Image
stanley_2024_hero.help: Choose the modern reality's masthead photograph from the Asset Repository. On first use STANLEY chooses an existing image so THE OTHER SIDE never arrives empty; your selection then remains fixed until you change it.

header_image.label: Header Banner Image
header_image.help: Optional photo for Kubrick's blue header position. Recommended 1260x300px. Leave blank for the faithful blue gradient.
header_image.hint: Recommended 1260x300px. Leave blank for the classic blue gradient.

header_logo.label: Custom Logo
header_logo.help: Upload a logo to replace the site title text in the banner. Transparent PNG recommended.

show_tagline.label: Show Tagline
show_tagline.help: Hide the tagline under the banner (useful when your logo already includes it). Still used in RSS and social/SEO meta.

accent_color.label: Unvisited Link Colour
accent_color.help: The normal colour for links that have not been visited.

active_link_color.label: Active Link Colour
active_link_color.help: The colour while a link is being clicked or tapped.

banner_bottom_color.label: Header Banner — Bottom
banner_bottom_color.help: Together with the top colour, replaces Kubrick's classic blue gradient.

show_sidebar.label: Show Sidebar
show_sidebar.help: The right-hand sidebar with recent posts and pages, as in the original.
